title.value: University of Otago City of Literature PhD Scholarship
title.evidence_quote: University of Otago City of Literature PhD Scholarship

field: Literature (PhD research on a topic relevant to literature)
qualifications: Graduates in any discipline intending to undertake PhD research on a topic relevant to literature
Applicants must be obtaining their first doctoral qualification
Offered annually to support one PhD candidate; applications reviewed after 31 January each year
description_short: Annual University of Otago scholarship for one PhD candidate researching literature, marking Dunedin's UNESCO City of Literature status. It provides a NZ$34,128 yearly stipend plus a domestic tuition fee waiver. Applications close 31 January.

compensation.value: NZ$34,128 stipend per annum plus domestic tuition fee waiver (excludes student services fee)
